profiles.label: Primary and secondary education
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find incident reports with quoted count-bearing phrases such as "students were inside", "children were inside", "students were evacuated", "pupils were evacuated", or "inside the school when" for elementary schools, primary schools, middle schools, high schools, secondary schools, preschools, and childcare centers. Prioritize news articles, official reports, and official attendance announcements; treat enrollment, directory, map, and generic school profile pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
official school district or school incident announcement
context_only_source_types: generic school profile page without a count-bearing event or incident
enrollment, capacity, or annual statistics page
social media repost without an original authoritative source

profiles.label: University and college
profiles.source_search_prompt: Find incident reports with quoted count-bearing phrases such as "students were inside", "people were evacuated", "occupants were evacuated", "students were rescued", or "inside the campus building when" for universities, colleges, dormitories, lecture halls, laboratories, libraries, and campus buildings. Prioritize news articles, official reports, and official campus safety announcements; treat enrollment, rankings, directory, and generic campus pages as context only.
preferred_source_types: official emergency or public-safety incident report
context_only_source_types: generic campus profile page without a count-bearing event or incident
enrollment, capacity, ranking, or statistics page
social media repost without an original authoritative source
